_doc: Item-overhaul v2 affixes (2026-06-04). Three families: generic (apply to any spell + any gear), class (boost one Str/Dex/Int spell class), archetype (behaviour affixes that rewrite what one spell DOES; reachable both as implicit_affixes on a signature item and as a weighted roll from a rare+ item's affix_pool, and restricted to their own archetype by the optional `base_types` field). Tiers are [min, max] 2-arrays per rarity (common→legendary) so each affix rolls a real range. AffixSystem.roll_affixes_for picks an integer in [min, max] inclusive at the correct rarity tier. Range damage affixes (e.g. of_embers) emit two values: bonus_min and bonus_max for the X-Y damage line in tooltips. The 'kind' field on each affix tells the formatter how to display it ('flat', 'pct', 'range', 'flag').

predicates.label: Berserker: HP low + peak ramp active

affixes._doc: Tier 2 mana-rework 2026-06-17 — aurastacker / archmage affix lane. of_zeal reduces aura reservation cost so a small-pool build can fit more auras. of_archmage scales spell damage with cast cost — the aurastacker payoff (gives up pool to fit auras → bigger casts hit proportionally harder). Both route through existing caps so number ceiling holds.
affixes.name: of Zeal

affixes._doc: Tier 3 mana-rework 2026-06-17 — build-expression affixes. Each enables a distinct caster archetype. high_tide rewards keeping the pool topped (Battlemage). siphon refunds mana on spell-hit (Sustain). clarity gives free-cast procs (lucky-feeling). mind_over_matter converts mana into a damage shield (Tanky-Mage). overflow_strike+evade complete the STR/DEX sustain stories.
affixes.name: of the High Tide

affixes._doc: PLAYTEST 2026-06-15 #28 + 2026-06-11sec #15 — visual-flair affixes. Lift prismatic/inverse/twisted/umbral from authored items to rollable affixes. flag-kind: writes a boolean stat on the bot at recompute. Visual rendering reads the stat via UITheme.flavor_color_for / item_cell.gd's flavor-tag pipeline. Mechanic: actor.gd reads each visual_* field from the bot. Common+ across slots so any drop can roll prestige.
affixes.name: of Umbra

predicates.label: Kiter: enemy near AND flee-vector exists
Executioner: target HP below finisher threshold
Glass Cannon: bot HP at full-strength threshold
Hunter: bound target is a boss
Grinder: enemies alive or loot visible on floor

affixes._doc: P4 PROOF AFFIX 2026-08-07 — the first two-sided affix in the game. Big single-target damage bought with a real area cut, so Fireball becomes a sniper instead of a crowd-clearer. The cost rides in extra_stats and is stored POSITIVE; SpellData.penalty_scale converts it to a multiplier at the seven area consumption sites. It CANNOT be expressed as negative spell_area_pct — stat_calc.gd:771 clamps that sum at 0.0 (58 of 62 clamps floor at zero) and the sums are global across all five equipped spells, so the cost would both vanish on a bare bot and hit the wrong spells.
affixes.name: of the Focused Core

affixes._doc: P4 PROOF AFFIX 2026-08-07 — second two-sided shape, deliberately costing a DIFFERENT resource so Beat 1 proves the substrate generalises past one stat. Wider freeze bought with a mana surcharge, which is the one cost channel that needs no new clamp handling: mana_cost_pct is already signed (-50..50, stat_calc.gd:653) and compute_mana_cost applies the per-item surcharge before the global pct. Reads as: the nova covers the room, but you cast it less often.
affixes.name: of the Hoarfrost Bloom

affixes._doc: P4 Beat 2 trade #1 - big damage bought with a real area cut, so a wide sweep becomes an executioner's swing. Cleave is the roster's only physical sweep and its 30 base damage is the highest of any spell, which makes it the right carrier: the upside is felt immediately and the narrowed arc is felt immediately too.
affixes.name: of the Culling Edge

affixes._doc: P4 Beat 2 trade #2 - damage for cooldown: the spell becomes an event rather than a rotation filler. Carried by Holy Pillars, the 95-degree/3-cell stomp half of P2's beam split, whose 14.0s cooldown is already the roster's longest so the surcharge lands on a spell the player is ALREADY choosing to wait for. NOTE the surcharge multiplies this spell's own cooldown in compute_cooldown; it is NOT routed through the bot-wide spell_cdr_pct lane, which would have slowed all five equipped spells.
affixes.name: of the Long Fuse

affixes._doc: P4 Beat 2 trade #3 - the aurastacker tax. A stronger aura bought with mana, which is the one cost an aura build genuinely feels: P2 measured a pure-aura build at 283% funded with mana 'genuinely irrelevant as specified', so a mana cost is the only lever that can make an aura decision hurt. aura_effect_pct exists because P3 found Grace's +10 evasion was a hardcoded constant with no scalable knob.
affixes.name: of the Squandered Ward

affixes._doc: P4 Beat 2 trade #4 - risk for power, the one trade whose cost is paid OUTSIDE the spell. Vampiric greed on Drain: the bolt hits harder and every incoming hit hurts more. Routes through the new spell_vulnerability_surcharge_pct lane (bot.gd) which SUBTRACTS from mit_sum in actor.gd::resolve_swing, mirroring the existing harm tag. Deliberately not a negative damage_taken_pct: that stat is MITIGATION clamped 0..40 upstream, so a negative would have been erased.
affixes.name: of the Ravening Coil

affixes._doc: P4 Beat 2 trade #5 - reach for punch. More chain jumps bought with damage, so the arc clears a room but cannot finish an elite. Reuses spell_chain_jumps, the stat of_storm_brand already feeds into _fire_chain_lightning's jump_count, so no new hook was needed on the upside; the cost is the Beat-1 damage channel. Chain Lightning became droppable for everyone in P1 when Dean cut the elf race anchor.
affixes.name: of the Thin Veil

affixes._doc: P4 Beat 2 trade #6 - a chokepoint puddle instead of a room-filler. Long life bought with area. Venom Cloud is the right carrier because P2 already tuned its lifetime against its own cooldown (8s/7.2s = 111% was permanent uptime, retuned to 9.2s), so extending life is a meaningful knob rather than a no-op, and the area cut is what stops it becoming free permanent coverage.
affixes.name: of the Withered Bloom

affixes._doc: UNIQUE-ONLY signature (2026-08-07, Dean: unique gear modifiers should be 'almost build defining like a lot of poe's low level uniques'). RULE REWRITE, not a number: a reaction that fires also re-arms its own trigger status on the target, so a single combo can chain into itself. Turns the reaction web from a one-shot payoff into a loop, which is the entire build. Read in spell_reactions.try_hit_reaction. Deliberately NOT in any affix_pool - it reaches the player only as an implicit on Emberloop Torc, so a random amulet can never roll it.
affixes.name: of the Kindled Chain

affixes._doc: UNIQUE-ONLY signature (2026-08-07). RULE REWRITE: every spell you cast counts as EVERY element for reaction purposes, so any spell can trigger any reaction. Normally a build must equip the right damage type to open a combo (fire->poisoned = ignite); this removes that constraint entirely and makes loadout-building free-form. Costs 25% spell damage as the price, expressed as a real trade via the P4 extra_stats substrate. Read in actor._apply_typed_damage's reaction gate.
affixes.name: of the Glass Prism

affixes._doc: UNIQUE-ONLY signature (2026-08-07). RULE REWRITE: your aura reservation is refunded entirely, but your maximum mana is halved. An aurastacker build normally trades pool for auras; this inverts the arithmetic so auras are free and spenders become the scarce thing. P2 measured a pure-aura build at 283% funded with mana 'genuinely irrelevant', so this is the item that makes that build shape a DECISION. Read in stat_calc's aura-reservation lane.
affixes.name: of the Hollow Vessel
